name: Reacts to tile hazards
description: Fire/lava/spark tiles the enemy overlaps apply their element to it (through its reactions), rate-limited by cooldownMs.

name: Element reactions table

name: Stunnable (sleep + wake)
description: While stunned the enemy does nothing at all; when the stun timer runs out it wakes into wakeTo.
script: halt; // stunned enemies skip everything else, wake tick included

name: Chases on sight
description: Forward vision cone: seeing the player escalates to chase; losing them (hidden, smoke, or loseMs without sight) gives up into giveUpTo.
script: var halfSlope = 0.55;   // vertical spread of the cone

name: Patrols a route
description: Drifts between its patrol bounds, refusing steps it can't safely take (walls, refused elements, drops deeper than a tile). Blocked both ways = stand still.

name: Returns to its post
description: In the return state, walks back toward its spawn point, then settles back into patrol once it arrives.

name: Gravity + walking physics
description: Applies gravity and resolves movement against the map. Hitting a wall while patrolling flips the facing.

name: Trappable
description: Walking onto a player-placed trap captures this enemy (removed from play, trap consumed).

name: Brazier flame
description: Water douses a lit brazier; fire relights a cold one. Flowing/pooled water tiles touching it douse it too.

name: Use: swing
description: F swings the item in an arc ahead: lights/scoops the carrier first if it can, otherwise applies the item's element to tiles, enemies, and braziers in reach. Consumables spend themselves on a real effect.

name: Use: splash
description: F splashes the item's element over a wide area ahead, then the container reverts to its empty form.
script: if (n == 0) { sfx("craftFail"); } // nothing in reach reacted

name: Use: place
description: F places the item in front of the player (spring pad or trap). E takes it back.

name: Use: throw
description: F lobs the item; hold to charge the arc. It bursts into a smoke veil where it lands.

name: Doused by an element
description: Standing in the item's dousedBy element reverts it to its doused form (a lit torch goes out in water) — wherever it sits in the inventory.

name: Lights near fire
description: Just holding this up to any flame (fire tiles, burning tiles, lit braziers) lights it into its lit form — no button press needed.

name: Lights braziers while held
description: Carrying this (a lit fire source) into a cold brazier lights the brazier.
